name: common-state-future-credit-v1
objective: Three measured H16 future-probe losses, one common state: target[a]=clamp((loss[HOLD]-loss[a])/(abs(loss[HOLD])+1e-6),-1,1). HOLD target is zero. Mean three-head Huber delta=1, simultaneous update from pre-fit weights.
replay_order: ascending seed, then ascending checkpoint; identical order each epoch; all three heads fitted together
old_state_replay_gate: Every old host_step, checkpoint state hash, branch step and measured outcome must reproduce before features are associated with old H16 targets. Final body, moments, controls and source policy bytes must match.

controls.initial: Does future experience alter weights, scores and selected actions at identical source history?
controls.simple: Frozen life after SimpleLLM future-credit fitting; transfer to new-seed HeVLM evaluation states.
controls.adapted: Does fitting separate HeVLM experience change the frozen parent's choices and measured future consequences?
controls.source: Greedy source life trained with the original immediate feedback at that exact state.
controls.push: Fixed action that won immediate loss in all sixteen development states.

readout: C loads exact source life, checks captured observation/features, copies only 163 fitted weights into that source history, disables exploration on the temporary copy and calls nt_chuck_architect_select. Chosen action is paired with its actually executed common-state branch.
metrics: raw and normalized selected advantage versus HOLD
regret versus minimum measured future loss
choice changes versus initial and frozen parent
immediate and held-out losses reported separately
fit_state: Only network weights change. Online history/RNG/counters and v1 format remain intact; fitting steps and objective identity are external receipts.
tie_rule: Exact recorded F32 loss equality; retain every tied minimum.
host_policy: Unchanged original immediate-feedback Architect, seeds matched to each host run.
host_noninterference: Independent control and probe hosts must match every step and final state bytes.

prior_smoke_exposure.interpretation: Seed101 remains fixed-protocol evaluation with prior smoke exposure. Seed211 is separately reported untouched confirmation. Final-run life sealing precedes final outcome generation.
